function.name: get_net_worth
function.description: Get total net worth and breakdown across cash/accounts, investments, policies, and debt. Use this for overall asset breakdowns or total net worth queries.

function.name: get_envelope_summary
function.description: Get budget envelopes for a given month: total budgeted, spent, remaining, and per-category breakdown. Use this for queries about budget limits, category spending, budgeted amounts, or envelope remaining funds.

month.description: YYYY-MM format, e.g. 2026-05. Defaults to current month.

function.name: get_monthly_summary
function.description: Get total income, total expenses, and net cash flow for a specific month. Use this for overall monthly budget surplus/deficit, income/expense totals, or savings rate questions.

month.description: YYYY-MM format. Defaults to current month.

function.name: get_accounts
function.description: Get all bank and savings accounts with active balances. Use this for bank names, account types, or individual bank balances.

function.name: get_transactions
function.description: Get recent transactions with optional filters. Use this to search by payee, find recent purchases, or filter transactions by account, category, or date range.

function.name: get_investment_summary
function.description: Get all investments with purchase value, current value, gains/losses, units, and asset type. Use this for mutual funds, stocks, gold, portfolio performance, or investment list.

function.name: get_policy_timeline
function.description: Get insurance premium due dates, payouts, and maturity events. Use this for insurance policy details, premium schedules, or upcoming policy payouts.

years.description: How many years ahead to look, default 5

function.name: get_exchange_rates
function.description: Get latest currency exchange rates (all currencies converted to INR). Use this to get foreign exchange conversion rates.

function.name: refresh_investment_price
function.description: Fetch live market price for an investment. Use this when the user asks to update or refresh investment performance.

investment_id.description: ID of the investment to refresh

function.name: refresh_exchange_rates
function.description: Fetch latest exchange rates from the web. Use this to update currency values to their latest market value.

currency.description: Specific currency to refresh (USD, SGD, NTD). Leave empty to refresh all.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Perform basic mathematical calculations like interest, budget allocations, percentages, sums, or conversions. Accepts mathematical expressions containing only numbers and operators +, -, *, /, (, ). DO NOT attempt math inside regular responses, always use this tool.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '120000 * 0.15' or '3 * (120000 - 45000)'
